en.topic_title: Hong Kong Tiananmen vigil activists to be sentenced on Friday, facing max. penalty of 10 years’ jail
en.topic_summary:
Three Hong Kong Tiananmen vigil activists convicted under the national security law will be sentenced this Friday, with each of them facing maximum penalties of 10 years behind bars.



Former Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China Albert Ho (left), Lee Cheuk-yan (centre) and Chow Hang-tung (right) at Victoria Park in Hong Kong on June 4, 2020, after the annual Tiananmen vigil was banned on public health grounds because of Covid-19. Photo: Anthony Wallace/AFP.
